source_admission: Published values cited in README.md, with how far each was read for this study on 2026-10-17. The study's numbers are arithmetic on the GCM's output and the project's committed products; the one outside source gives a human limit for reading the wet-bulb temperatures. No outside dataset or full paper is committed.

sources.citation: Vecellio DJ, Wolf ST, Cottle RM, Kenney WL 2022, Evaluating the 35 C wet-bulb temperature adaptability threshold for young, healthy subjects (PSU HEAT Project), Journal of Applied Physiology 132(2), 340-345
sources.use: README: a wet-bulb temperature near 31 C as about where young, healthy adults doing light activity in warm, humid air can no longer hold their core temperature steady, against the 35 C theoretical limit
sources.access: known from the literature as its abstract states it (critical wet-bulb temperatures of about 30-31 C in warm, humid conditions at light activity); not re-read for this study
